title: How to Guide a Session (from The Boo Hoo Bible)
author: Art Kleps
summary: Art Kleps's chapter on running an LSD session from The Boo Hoo Bible (1971), the Neo-American Church catechism and handbook. The section covers set, setting, and the guide's preparation and temperament, written in Kleps's mix of deadpan comedy and practical session-craft.
excerpt: There are a variety of requirements to assure the success of a guided session, but chief among them is the conspicuous presence in the session room of a copy of Popular Mechanics (in the case of women, a magazine such as Cosmopolitan should be substituted). All statues of people with three or more arms should be removed, as well as all dogs, goats, blackbirds, insects, people who are too bad, people who are too good...
citation: Art Kleps, "How to Guide a Session," in The Boo Hoo Bible: The Neo-American Church Catechism (San Cristobal, N.M.: Toad Books, 1971), 147-152.
rights: In copyright, Art Kleps estate / Neo-American Church. Freely republished on the church's own current website (okneoac.org); not cleared for full republication here.
